entities.name: Elder Dragons of Dominaria
entities.description: Ancient dragons whose power rivaled planeswalkers; they took part in the Elder Dragon War that killed most of their kind.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon of Dominaria who became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who became a planeswalker and is the ancestor of the dragonlords of Tarkir.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: A conflict that shook Dominaria and killed most of the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Five dragons hatched from vortices of overlapping mana who founded Strixhaven and mastered the five opposing mana combinations.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The elite school of mages founded by the Founder Dragons, with five colleges named after them.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane whose birth produced five Founder Dragons.

entities.name: Shadrix Silverquill
entities.description: A Founder Dragon after whom Silverquill college is named.

entities.name: Galazeth Prismari
entities.description: A Founder Dragon after whom Prismari college is named.

entities.name: Beledros Witherbloom
entities.description: A Founder Dragon after whom Witherbloom college is named.

entities.name: Velomachus Lorehold
entities.description: A Founder Dragon after whom Lorehold college is named.

entities.name: Director Taiva
entities.description: The human mouthpiece of the Founder Dragons.

entities.name: Founder Sphinxes
entities.description: The Elder Sphinxes of Echoverse Arcavios who founded the Hexhaven colleges and grew self-centered and indifferent.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The school of Echoverse Arcavios with five allied-color colleges.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose Echoverse contains Hexhaven.

entities.name: Denzilore Fatehold
entities.description: An Elder Sphinx founder of a Hexhaven college.

entities.name: Ingris Stingerquill
entities.description: An Elder Sphinx founder of a Hexhaven college.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who struck a bargain with four demons, the mightiest being the Elder Demon of Dominaria.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane covered by the Elder Demon that expanded across it.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose vampires were indirectly created by its Elder Demon.

entities.name: Elder Dinosaurs of Ixalan
entities.description: The greatest of the dinosaurs, ancient and untamable, whose tale took Huatli two years to memorize.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A character who spent two years memorizing the tale of the Elder Dinosaurs.

entities.name: Etali
entities.description: An Elder Dinosaur of Ixalan.

entities.name: Nephilim Epochal
entities.description: An elder nephilim of Ravnica whose awakening awoke the five other nephilim.

entities.name: Dragonlords of Tarkir
entities.description: Dragons on Tarkir given the Elder type, not of the Elder Dragon species, who are direct descendants of Ugin.

entities.name: Titans of Theros
entities.description: The Elder Giants of Theros, including Phlage and Skotha.

entities.name: Phlage
entities.description: Titan of Burning Wind and Fire's Fury, an all-consuming whirlwind of fire.

entities.name: Skotha
entities.description: Titan of Eternal Dark, the utter darkness of the starless night.

events.summary: At the birth of Arcavios, overlapping mana forms five vortices that hatch five dragons.
events.quote: Five particularly powerful vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons

events.summary: The Founder Dragons, once angered at mortals harnessing magic, found Strixhaven to teach disciplined study of the five mana dichotomies.
events.quote: the dragons founded an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

events.summary: The Elder Dragons of Dominaria fight the Elder Dragon War, which kills most of their kind.
events.quote: a conflict that shook the plane of Dominaria and killed most of their kind

events.summary: The Elder Demon expands to cover the entire plane of Duskmourn.
events.quote: The powerful demon that expanded and covered the entire plane of Duskmourn .

events.summary: The Nephilim Epochal's awakening awakens the five other nephilim.
events.quote: Its awakening subsequently awoke the five other nephilim.

relations.quote: they are the direct descendants of Ugin

relations.note: Each college founded by an Elder Sphinx.
relations.quote: each of which was founded by an Elder Sphinx
